summary_it: Qualifiche reali eseguite e limiti documentati; nessuna dichiarazione di miglioramento dei pesi, validazione umana o campagna formale completata.

required_jobs: Verify Web runners and fixture contracts
verified_jobs: Verify Web runners and fixture contracts

jvm.publication_limitation: The new sealed catalog is eligible alone. Combining it with the previously published same-version catalog produces native CONFLICTING decisions for all three profiles; production adoption requires explicit profile/catalog revision handling, preserving historical evidence.
jvm.source_identity: Exact uncommitted source bytes retained and hash verified; base commit alone does not identify these changes.
jvm.change: Gradle SETUP budget 600 seconds; strict dependency resolver now emits per-configuration progress and elapsed duration. Historical dependency preparation hashes retained with their original runner source snapshots.

step_3.execution_image_policy: Generated-code JVM probes used the historically validated exact runner images after native admission rejected the new unpromoted Gradle image. No capability check was bypassed. The new image is assessed independently in the fresh fixture campaign.

latest_findings.WEB_STATIC: TEST fails: app.createReservation is not a function. Supplemental independent core oracle also finds missing public export and retrieval.
latest_findings.JVM_JAVA: BUILD fails: int identifiers incompatible with String map keys and retrieval parameter.
latest_findings.JVM_KOTLIN: Main BUILD passes; TEST compilation fails on missing assertNotNull and nonexistent emptyString. Source inspection also shows whitespace-only guest names accepted; this last point was not separately executed.
latest_findings.JVM_SCALA: Rejected before execution: generated production Main extends FunSuite and provides no valid application entrypoint.

real_repairs.result: Both model responses rejected as INVALID_PROVIDER_OUTPUT. They declare application/octet-stream outside the generated text-source contract and do not correct the observed Java/Kotlin defects.

independent_business_oracle.scope: Supplemental white-box offline engineering checks, not governed Level D evidence.

step_3.methodology: Approved upstream artifacts in these source probes are controlled synthetic inputs. Source/provider and execution APIs are real; the probes are not complete formal thesis workflows. Fixture repair success must not be reported as model repair success.

step_4.metric_limit: A passing narrow schema/judgment/criterion/reference check does not establish free-text fidelity or complete multi-control artifact quality. Case 5 contains a wrong selector in its recommendation despite a correct structured location.

dataset.split_policy: Whole counterfactual groups and translations; test/validation task phrases absent from train across all families.
limitations: Closed HTML fixture grammar, not a general accessibility oracle.
Template-generated targets are not representative real-user labels.
Independent held-out inference is required before candidate selection.
Historical S66/S67 and formal case evidence are unchanged.

retained_rejections: Broad second-round evaluation misses the empty button; STOP decision retained.
Focused recovery changes the scenario explicitly. First Twin rationale falsely says content was absent; only the supported second-Twin finding and verified HTML bytes authorize the button revision.
step_5.scope: Native authorized evaluation, independent Twin calls, aggregation and exact delegated engineering decisions over immutable external artifact versions. Not an application SQL workflow, owner UI session, actual human judgment or model-weight update.

blockers: formal case execution requires a clean working tree

preflight.observed_profiles_scope: Implementation targets that completed positive fixture attempts during this diagnostic run. This does not assert whole-campaign Level D eligibility or current application database publication.
execution_order_after_qualification: User commits reviewed changes; verify pushed commit and CI.
Complete fresh Web validation on a clock-stable execution host; seal exact runner evidence.
Select and freeze evaluator and source runtimes that pass independent validation, preserving rejected candidates.
Freeze a new campaign plan on the final exact commit; create new case attempts through governed APIs and recorded gates.
Run Web calculator, hotel management and weather comparison cases with the same protocol and platform commit.
Export actual governed records, raw synthetic feedback and metrics; perform expert review separately with real reviewers.

expert_review.participants: Four actual expert reviewers E1-E4, not model personas
expert_review.assignment: 60 pairs, 2 ratings per pair, 30 per reviewer; 11 items; blinded randomized order; retain raw ratings and separate randomization key.

plan.candidate_selection: Review labels and choose training settings using only the training and validation splits. Freeze the selected adapter hashes before the reserved final evaluation. Preserve every unsuccessful candidate. Do not tune using reserved final outputs.
plan.review_scope: The closed HTML grammar labels have schema, native-domain and structural-oracle checks. This is not representative real-user annotation, expert ratings or a general browser accessibility oracle.
plan.promotion: Passing narrow synthetic screening is required but not sufficient. Also assess real complete artifact scenarios, several simultaneous controls, regression on retained broader cases and operator review. No automatic production selection.

separate_source_model.required_data: Separately reviewed requirements-to-source and compiler-log-to-repair examples, with independently executed business assertions. Current failed outputs are diagnostic negative examples, never positive training targets.

plan.gpu_use: Run one loaded model at a time on the observed 8 GiB GPU; no model server may occupy it during training.

diagnostic_result.comparison: All 36 model-visible message pairs and input token counts are identical; schema decoding and per-case limits are equal. This is a diagnostic cohort already observed, not the reserved final test.

plan.additional_pretraining_review: Prepared examples cover narrow relational criteria with distractors. Review labels and add separately grouped multi-control artifact scenarios plus faithful free-text action references before claiming broader improvement. The current 36 diagnostic cases must not be treated as an untouched final test.

retraining.additional_training_data_review: The prepared curriculum covers individual relational criteria with distractors. Add/review complete multi-control artifact examples and faithful narrative/action references before claiming broad evaluator quality. No hyperparameter or larger-model choice is assumed to improve quality without paired validation.
retraining.coder_is_separate: Evaluator adapter training cannot improve the separate source coder. Source training needs reviewed requirements-to-code and failure-to-repair pairs that actually compile and satisfy independent functional assertions.

tests.full_suite_skip_scope: Windows symlink/POSIX and separately opted-in Docker/local inference tests. JVM Windows skips are covered by retained Linux tests; real inference/execution probes are separate engineering evidence.

commit_suggestion: feat(evaluation): qualify real models and prepare controlled retraining
